intro: Football is the most popular sport in Sierra Leone.

chapters.title: Football
text: The Leone Stars played at the Africa Cup of Nations in 2022 after 26 years away and drew with holders Algeria.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Amputee football teams, formed by war survivors, have competed internationally.

keyTerms.meaning: Football for players who have lost a limb.
